value.rationale: This complete reduced geometric classification concerns a natural nilpotent locus inside an established and structurally complicated noncommutative quadratic algebra. It determines all characteristic-two rational points and irreducible components for arbitrary n, separates scalar weights from graph support and proves non-equidimensionality for n≥4. A Bell-number specialization links group-theoretic algebra relations and complete set-partition geometry. These statements do not follow from the known Hilbert series, abstract support grading or commutative quotient alone without the new quadratic-triple analysis.
